### 有趣用法和干货
1. **Thorsten Ball's "How I work with Agents" went mega-viral overnight**: Amp engineer Thorsten Ball finally published the agent-workflow notes he'd been DMing friends — 5,400+ bookmarks and 2,500+ likes in hours. Core rules as of Oct 2026: use the latest models only; prompt the What not the How; make the whole SDLC visible to the agent (logs, deploy, flags, bug reports); ask for irrefutable proof (demos, before/after numbers) and put "this is not evidence" in AGENTS.md; don't iterate with the agent — make it build tools to iterate; don't wait on agents, lean into async/heartbeat; stop hand-managing context (compaction works); review only high-blast-radius code. https://x.com/thorstenball/status/2114386050638336082 | https://x.com/i/article/2114385531811319808 · 全文 Full text: [site](https://naijoug.github.io/dailyai/article/thorsten-ball-how-i-work-with-agents/) / [md](../../articles/thorsten-ball-how-i-work-with-agents.md)
> **[zh]** **Thorsten Ball《How I work with Agents》一夜爆火**：Amp 工程师 Thorsten Ball 终于把一直私信给朋友的 Agent 工作法写成文，几小时内超 5400 收藏、2500 赞。截至 2026 年 10 月的核心原则：只用最新模型；说要什么别说怎么做；让 Agent 能看见整条 SDLC（日志、部署、开关、工单）；要求不可辩驳的证据（演示、前后数据），并在 AGENTS.md 写上「这不算证据」；别跟 Agent 来回试——让它自己做工具去试；别干等 Agent，用异步和心跳；别手管上下文（压缩已经够用）；只审爆炸半径大的代码。

> **[zh]** **Vox：给 AGENTS.md 加一行，阻止 Agent 宁可跟过时文档也不跟能跑的代码**：研究者设了文档与代码不一致的陷阱；Claude Code 80 次里有 79 次跟旧文档，Codex 4 次里有 1 次甚至把能跑的代码改成迁就过时文档。加上这行后，两个 Agent 跟代码的比例都从 4% 升到 91%：「当仓库文档和现有代码不一致时，遵循现有代码里的约定，并在最终回复里指出你发现的每一处文档与代码不一致。」

1. **ThinkRail: JetBrains' open-source agentic IDE built around the pi coding agent**: isolated git-worktree workspaces so agents work in parallel without touching your checkout, a real Monaco workbench with terminals and diffs, concurrent pi chats with live token/cost readout, and a living SPEC.md graph the agent reads and maintains through dedicated tools; also MCP, Agent Skills, JetBrains AI or your own provider credentials. 2. **MuscleMemory: open-source procedural memory for coding agents that learns only from proven successes**: watches Claude Code / Codex sessions and, when a task ends with tests passing, stores a short skill (files to touch, the proving test, what to avoid); on similar tasks it injects that note into the prompt. Benchmarks claim ~25% fewer input tokens / ~30% fewer tool calls / ~28% less time with Codex still passing, and a Claude Code + Sonnet 5.5 run cut input tokens ~43%; local by default, Apache-2.0. https://thewariend.com/musclememory [GitHub](https://github.com/TheWariend/MuscleMemory)
> **[zh]** **MuscleMemory：给编程 Agent 用的开源程序性记忆，只从「真正跑通」的任务里学习**：旁观 Claude Code / Codex 会话，任务以测试通过收尾时记下一条短技能（该改哪些文件、用哪条测试证明、要避开什么）；下次类似任务就把这段注记塞进提示词。基准称 Codex 仍全过的情况下输入 token 约少 25%、工具调用约少 30%、耗时约少 28%，Claude Code + Sonnet 5.5 的一次试验输入 token 约少 43%；默认本地，Apache-2.0。
3. **iPhone Agent Harness: automate a real iPhone from Safari with a ~$2 ESP32 Bluetooth bridge — no Mac, app or jailbreak**: the harness runs in Safari (iOS / iPadOS 27+), reads the screen and talks to your chosen model, then drives the phone via an ESP32 emulating a Bluetooth keyboard/mouse on the same Wi-Fi; flash firmware from desktop Chrome/Edge, keep the bridge powered nearby, write reusable skills (e.g. order takeout). MIT; shared on V2EX overnight. https://igent.cc [GitHub](https://github.com/cccat6/iphone-agent-harness) [V2EX](https://www.v2ex.com/t/1251717)
> **[zh]** **iPhone Agent Harness：用 Safari + 约 2 美元的 ESP32 蓝牙桥，自动化操作真机 iPhone——不用 Mac、不用 App、不用越狱**：Harness 在 Safari（iOS / iPadOS 27+）里跑，读屏幕、调你自选的模型，再通过 ESP32 模拟蓝牙键鼠操控手机，和手机连同一 Wi-Fi；用桌面 Chrome/Edge 刷固件，桥接板单独供电放在旁边即可，常用流程可写成技能复用（例如点外卖）。MIT；昨晚在 V2EX 分享创造出现。
4. **VoiceStudio: open-source, fully local ElevenLabs-style voice studio — clone, design, dub, dictate and make audiobooks in 646 languages**: Electron app powered by k2-fsa/OmniVoice by default (other engines optional), with timed video dubbing, a floating dictation widget, local API and MCP for agents, recipes and watch folders; no account required for local workflows. AGPL-3.0; ~87k GitHub stars and on today's trending list. https://voicestudio.sh [GitHub](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio)

5. **Limitbreak: one Claude Code install, several Claude accounts — auto-switches mid-session when a usage limit hits**: a tiny local Go proxy sits on `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, retries the same `/v1/messages` request on the next account when Anthropic returns a window/weekly rejection, and never sets `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` so connectors and MCP keep working; tokens stay in Keychain / `.credentials.json`. MIT; Show HN overnight. https://github.com/radu2lupu/limitbreak

### 科技新闻
1. **Tailworm: researcher publishes 11 unpatched Tailscale / headscale flaws; Tailscale SSH unix-socket forwarding can yield root on another node**: Erica Windisch (Cyberdione Labs) reproduced findings on Tailscale v1.104.2 and headscale v0.29.5 (tested Oct 22–24), including High-severity issues where `ssh -L`/`-R` unix-socket forwarding dials or replaces sockets as root, TOCTOU races past path allowlists, serve-to-localapi write access, and conn25 egress privilege gaps; she recommends disabling Tailscale SSH and App Connectors for now. Tailscale says it was already reviewing the same areas and will share more; no bulletin yet. https://tailworm.com/ [pwn.watch](https://pwn.watch/i/tailscale-tailworm-ssh-forwarding-privesc)
> **[zh]** **Tailworm：研究者公开 11 个尚未修补的 Tailscale / headscale 漏洞；Tailscale SSH 的 unix socket 转发可在另一节点拿到 root**：Erica Windisch（Cyberdione Labs）在 Tailscale v1.104.2 与 headscale v0.29.5 上复现（测试窗口 10/22–24），高危项包括 `ssh -L`/`-R` unix socket 转发以 root 拨号或替换 socket、TOCTOU 绕过路径白名单、serve 打到 localapi 的写权限，以及 conn25 出口权限缺口等；她建议暂时关闭 Tailscale SSH 和 App Connectors。Tailscale 称已在审查相同区域并会补充说明，目前尚无安全公告。

### 有趣用法和干货
1. **Addy Osmani: how the Claude Code team does code review when Claude writes ~90% of the code**: from June to September merged PRs more than doubled while the revert share fell 40%+. The setup: pre-PR verification (make Claude show runnable proof, then a fresh-context subagent reviews the diff), a Claude review on every PR with multi-agent bug hunts and voting to cut false positives, a blocking security review, CI, human approval tiered by a risk classifier (agent approvals never count; re-approve after untrusted commits), merge queue + flags + staged rollout, and fast rollback. Lessons: cap review cycles at three (one PR looped 50+ times overnight; ~59% of re-flags were old code), use incident PRs as the reviewer's eval set, and keep humans for "should we build this", dangerous code, architecture and ownership. 8,800+ bookmarks. https://x.com/addyosmani/status/2114604912520921136 · 全文 Full text: [site](https://naijoug.github.io/dailyai/article/addy-osmani-claude-code-code-review/) / [md](../../articles/addy-osmani-claude-code-code-review.md)
> **[zh]** **Addy Osmani：Claude 写了约 90% 代码时，Claude Code 团队怎么做代码评审**：6 月到 9 月合并的 PR 翻倍多，回滚占比降了 40% 以上。做法：提 PR 前先验证（让 Claude 拿出可运行的证据，再由全新上下文的子 Agent 审 diff）；每个 PR 都有 Claude 评审，多 Agent 并行找 bug 并投票压误报；可阻断的安全评审；CI；按风险分类器分级的人工批准（Agent 批准永远不算，不可信提交后要重新批准）；合并队列 + 功能开关 + 分阶段发布；快速回滚。经验：评审最多三轮（曾有 PR 一夜循环 50 多次，约 59% 的重复标记是老代码），用引发事故的 PR 当评审员的评测集，人负责「该不该做」、危险代码、架构和担责。8800+ 收藏。
2. **poteto's takeaways from Yaron Minsky's talk on making your codebase agent-friendly**: agents thrive on feedback and types are one of the best kinds; make illegal states unrepresentable so types enforce global rules; use property-based tests, fuzzing, even full-system deterministic simulation; expect tests (print and capture output) make behavior legible and shrink review surface; and formal methods change ROI — seL4 took ~25 person-years with 23 lines of proof per line of C, but agents make that cheaper. 1,800+ bookmarks. https://x.com/poteto/status/2114626630429913383 | https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rUYP4C29yCw
> **[zh]** **poteto 总结 Yaron Minsky 演讲：如何把代码库改造得更适合 Agent**：Agent 靠反馈成长，类型是最好的反馈之一；让非法状态无法表示，类型就能在全库强制全局规则；用基于属性的测试、模糊测试，乃至全系统确定性模拟测试；expect test（把输出打印出来并固化进测试）让行为一目了然、缩小评审面；形式化方法的投入产出也变了——seL4 花了约 25 人年，每行 C 配 23 行证明，而 Agent 让这件事便宜得多。1800+ 收藏。
3. **Paul Iusztin's free course: learn harness engineering by building Claude Code from scratch**: after taking apart Claude Code, OpenCode and Pi, he published an open-source Python course (8 articles, 6 videos, 1 codebase) covering harness design, the bare agent loop, local/remote sandboxing, four context-engineering techniques, subagents, headless deploys (CLI, webhooks, cron), benchmarks and replaying failed runs. Sponsored by Modal, Opik and Kitaru. https://x.com/pauliusztin_/status/2114401218462105994 | https://github.com/decodingai-magazine/building-a-coding-agent-from-scratch-course
> **[zh]** **Paul Iusztin 免费课程：从零写一个 Claude Code 来学 harness 工程**：拆解 Claude Code、OpenCode 和 Pi 之后，他发布了开源的 Python 课程（8 篇文章、6 个视频、1 个代码库），涵盖 harness 设计、最简 Agent 循环、本地/远程沙箱、4 种上下文工程技巧、子 Agent、无头部署（CLI、webhook、cron）、基准评测和回放失败运行。由 Modal、Opik 和 Kitaru 赞助。
4. **Bruce Van：恶意 AGENTS.md 能劫持编程 Agent，三条自查**：Forever Security 报告称，用恶意 AGENTS.md 测试时 Codex 超过 90% 中招、Claude Code 约一半（研究人员自测），结论是没有漏洞可修——Agent 只是照着说明文件干活。自查：不在「下载」「桌面」这类杂物目录里启动 Agent；刚 clone 的仓库和别人发的压缩包，先自己看一眼 AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md；检查 `~/.codex/config.toml` 里有没有不认识的 mcp_servers。https://x.com/bruc3van/status/2114669805580235247 | https://forever.security/blog/hijacking-ai-agents-via-downloads-folder/
> **[en]** **Bruce Van: malicious AGENTS.md files can hijack coding agents — three self-checks**: Forever Security reports that in its own tests with a malicious AGENTS.md, Codex fell for it over 90% of the time and Claude Code about half the time, concluding there is no bug to patch — the agent just follows the instruction file. Checks: don't launch agents in junk folders like Downloads or Desktop; inspect AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md in freshly cloned repos and archives others send you; check `~/.codex/config.toml` for unfamiliar mcp_servers.

### 新产品
1. **AVP: open-source version control for coding agents, built to replace Git's branch → PR → CI loop**: each agent opens a task, writes and lands it, and every landing is proven against the exact head of main; two agents touching the same code get replayed one on the other instead of going through PRs. In their benchmark (8 Claude Code agents, 24 overlapping tasks) main went red 14/104 times with Git, 10/112 with Jujutsu and 0/102 with AVP; on Murmell's own monorepo PR CI runs fell from 104/day to 4 and median time-to-main from 19 to 3 minutes. Works alongside Git with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor; on Product Hunt today. https://avp.murmell.com/ [GitHub](https://github.com/Mossab28/avp)
> **[zh]** **AVP：给编程 Agent 用的开源版本控制，想取代 Git 的「分支 → PR → CI」循环**：每个 Agent 开任务、写代码、落地，且每次落地都要在 main 的最新 head 上证明通过；两个 Agent 改到同一处代码时，会把一方在另一方之上重放，而不是走 PR。在其基准里（8 个 Claude Code Agent、24 个相互重叠的任务），main 变红的次数：Git 104 次中 14 次、Jujutsu 112 次中 10 次、AVP 102 次中 0 次；在 Murmell 自家 monorepo 上，PR 的 CI 运行从每天 104 次降到 4 次，改动进 main 的中位时间从 19 分钟降到 3 分钟。可与 Git 并存，支持 Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor；今天上了 Product Hunt。
2. **OpenBot: a local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates across Codex, Claude Code, Grok and more**: each agent gets its own workspace and session (Codex App Server, Claude Code, plus Grok CLI, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor CLI and Cline via ACP, or custom OpenAI-compatible / local Ollama / LM Studio endpoints), with FIFO task queues, agent-to-agent messages and file transfers, shared channel chats with explicit delegation, auto-compaction, an embedded browser agents can drive and optional Computer Use. Development preview — agents run with full access and no per-action approval, so keep backups; PolyForm Noncommercial, ~1.2k stars and on GitHub Trending. https://openbot.run/ [GitHub](https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot)
> **[zh]** **OpenBot：本地优先的桌面工作区，把 Codex、Claude Code、Grok 等变成常驻 AI 队友**：每个 Agent 有独立工作区和会话（Codex App Server、Claude Code，以及通过 ACP 接入的 Grok CLI、OpenCode、Gemini、Cursor CLI、Cline，或自定义 OpenAI 兼容 / 本地 Ollama、LM Studio 端点），带 FIFO 任务队列、Agent 间消息和文件传递、明确分派任务的共享频道、自动压缩上下文、Agent 可操控的内嵌浏览器和可选的 Computer Use。目前是开发预览版——Agent 以完全权限运行、不逐项确认，记得备份；PolyForm 非商业许可，约 1.2k star，登上 GitHub Trending。
3. **PaperPilot: a zero-cloud, pure-Rust PDF engine you can hand to your agent via MCP**: one Rust core exposed as an MCP server (one-line config for Codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code, Pi, Claude Desktop, Cursor), a CLI, an in-browser WASM tool that uploads nothing, a Tauri desktop app and a local REST API; v0.6 covers merge/split/rotate/reorder, compress, text extraction and pure-Rust PaddleOCR, watermark, signature checks, PII scan and Excel → JSON/CSV, with Markdown/Office conversion on the roadmap. ~187 points on HN; commenters asked for password removal and signing, and one questioned whether it borrows from MuPDF's AGPL code. https://usepaperpilot.com [GitHub](https://github.com/KrushnaVardhanReddy/PaperPilot) [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50238739)
> **[zh]** **PaperPilot：零云端、纯 Rust 的 PDF 引擎，可通过 MCP 直接交给 Agent 用**：同一个 Rust 核心提供 MCP 服务器（Codex、Claude Code、Kimi Code、Pi、Claude Desktop、Cursor 一行生成配置）、CLI、不上传任何文件的浏览器 WASM 版、Tauri 桌面应用和本地 REST API；v0.6 支持合并/拆分/旋转/重排、压缩、文本提取和纯 Rust 的 PaddleOCR、水印、签名校验、PII 扫描以及 Excel → JSON/CSV，路线图上还有 Markdown/Office 互转。HN 约 187 分；评论里有人想要去密码和签名功能，也有人质疑是否借用了 MuPDF 的 AGPL 代码。
4. **ManyAgents: run a team of Claude Code and Codex agents from one Mac window**: an orchestrator splits your work across agents, each in its own git worktree; a reviewer agent checks the result, a built-in browser lets agents test their own work, and every question from every agent lands in one place. Uses the Claude/ChatGPT plans you already have; 14-day free trial; on Product Hunt today. https://manyagents.app
> **[zh]** **ManyAgents：在一个 Mac 窗口里指挥一队 Claude Code 和 Codex Agent**：编排器把工作拆给多个 Agent，各自在独立 git worktree 里干活；评审 Agent 检查结果，内置浏览器让 Agent 自测，所有 Agent 的提问都汇总到一处。直接用你已有的 Claude/ChatGPT 套餐；免费试用 14 天；今天上了 Product Hunt。
5. **proc: an agent-friendly CLI for process and port management**: target processes by port, PID, name or path — `proc kill :3000` ends whatever listens on 3000 (asks first, `--dry-run` previews), `proc :3000` shows name/PID/folder/CPU/memory, `--in .` limits actions to this project's processes, plus `why`, `tree`, `orphans`, `stuck`, `free`, `freeze/thaw` and an agent skill; macOS/Linux/Windows via crates.io, npm or Docker. On Show HN one commenter noted Claude often kills its own process killer when it hand-rolls this. https://proc-cli.com/ [GitHub](https://github.com/yazeed/proc-cli) [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50239041)
> **[zh]** **proc：对 Agent 友好的进程与端口管理 CLI**：按端口、PID、名称或路径定位进程——`proc kill :3000` 结束监听 3000 端口的进程（先确认，`--dry-run` 可预览），`proc :3000` 显示名称/PID/目录/CPU/内存，`--in .` 只作用于当前项目的进程，另有 `why`、`tree`、`orphans`、`stuck`、`free`、`freeze/thaw` 等命令和配套 Agent skill；支持 macOS/Linux/Windows，可经 crates.io、npm 或 Docker 安装。Show HN 评论里有人吐槽 Claude 自己手写杀进程脚本时，常把脚本自己先杀掉。

### 科技新闻
1. **Anthropic's S-1 numbers: $16.3B revenue and an $80.7B net loss in H1 2026, 900% net revenue retention**: Bloomberg reports H1 2025 was $1.2B revenue and a $13B loss; the FT says nearly $9B of the H1 loss came from compute and infrastructure and Anthropic has nearly $800B of commitments over 10 years. The prospectus also spells out the founders' pitch that AI is "one of the most consequential technologies in human history" and the ways Anthropic may act unlike a profit-maximizing company. ~257 points on HN, where reactions ranged from "adding a zero to revenue every year is wild" to calling it peak hype. https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1018476/anthropic-ipo-details-s1-filed-sec [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261026/p22#a261026p22) [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50242939)
> **[zh]** **Anthropic S-1 披露财务：2026 上半年营收 163 亿美元、净亏损 807 亿美元，净收入留存率 900%**：彭博称 2025 年上半年营收 12 亿美元、亏损 130 亿美元；FT 称上半年亏损中近 90 亿美元来自算力与基础设施，Anthropic 未来 10 年的承诺支出近 8000 亿美元。招股书还写明了创始人的主张——AI 是「人类历史上最具影响力的技术之一」——以及 Anthropic 可能不同于纯粹追求利润公司的做法。HN 约 257 分，反应从「营收每年多一个零太疯狂」到「这是泡沫顶点」都有。
2. **Cathedral, a months-old startup founded by ex-DOGE staffers, says AI agents breached Anthropic's internal systems in under 12 hours**: per The Washington Post, which reviewed the report, Cathedral told Anthropic its researchers quickly penetrated sensitive systems using AI agents. It lands the same day as the S-1 and right after Claude's own unprompted paywall bypass, sharpening questions about how well AI labs secure themselves against agent-driven attacks. https://www.techmeme.com/261026/p16#a261026p16
> **[zh]** **前 DOGE 成员创办的新公司 Cathedral 称，用 AI Agent 不到 12 小时就攻入 Anthropic 内部系统**：据看过报告的《华盛顿邮报》，Cathedral 告诉 Anthropic，其研究人员借助 AI Agent 很快就渗透进敏感系统。消息与 S-1 同日出现，又紧跟 Claude 自行绕过付费墙事件，让「AI 实验室自身能否防住 Agent 驱动的攻击」这个问题更尖锐。
3. **Fortinet quietly ships fixes for critical, AI-found flaws across FortiOS, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiMail and FortiAuthenticator — CVEs withheld until Nov 10**: the bugs came from Fortinet's frontier AI-assisted testing program; FortiMail/FortiAuthenticator fixes shipped Oct 21 and FortiOS/FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer Oct 22 (e.g. FortiOS 8.0.2, 7.6.8, 7.4.13, 7.2.14). Fortinet warns attackers can use AI to reverse-engineer patches, so upgrade internet-facing devices now; NHS England issued an alert. Separately, a dark-web seller is offering a pre-auth RCE-to-root PoC for the Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day CVE-2026-104935 for $3,000 (unverified). https://pwn.watch/i/fortinet-ai-found-flaws-hardening-release-oct-2026 [Ivanti](https://pwn.watch/i/ivanti-connect-secure-cve-2026-104935)
> **[zh]** **Fortinet 低调修复 FortiOS、FortiManager、FortiAnalyzer、FortiMail 和 FortiAuthenticator 中由 AI 发现的严重漏洞——CVE 延后到 11 月 10 日才公布**：漏洞来自 Fortinet 的前沿 AI 辅助测试项目；FortiMail/FortiAuthenticator 修复于 10 月 21 日发布，FortiOS/FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer 于 10 月 22 日发布（如 FortiOS 8.0.2、7.6.8、7.4.13、7.2.14）。Fortinet 警告攻击者能用 AI 逆向补丁，建议立即升级面向公网的设备；英格兰 NHS 已发警报。另外，暗网有人以 3000 美元兜售 Ivanti Connect Secure 零日 CVE-2026-104935 的免认证 RCE 提权到 root PoC（未经证实）。
4. **IBM CEO Arvind Krishna: open-weight models are now ~90% as good at 10–25% of the token cost, and fit in two or three racks on-prem**: on IBM's Q3 call he said the benchmark gap went from 70 vs 20–30 in 2024 to 70 vs 50 in late 2025, and that most enterprise tasks (emails, contracts, customer calls) don't need the frontier — but companies lack the kernel, networking and caching engineers to run it, which IBM wants to sell software (and Spyre accelerators) for. ~345 points on HN: skeptics say he's talking his book, while self-hosters report not paying for a model in months. https://www.theregister.com/systems/2026/10/22/ibm-ceo-says-open-weight-models-are-now-irresistibly-good-and-cheap-on-prem/5304640 [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50238088)
> **[zh]** **IBM CEO Arvind Krishna：开放权重模型如今能力约为前沿模型的 90%，token 成本只有 10–25%，本地两三个机柜就能跑**：他在 IBM 三季度财报会上说，基准差距从 2024 年的 70 对 20–30 缩小到 2025 年底的 70 对 50，大多数企业任务（写邮件、审合同、接客服电话）用不着前沿模型——但企业缺内核、网络和缓存方面的工程师来跑，这正是 IBM 想卖软件（和 Spyre 加速卡）的地方。HN 约 345 分：有人说他在替自家生意站台，也有自托管用户称已经几个月没为模型付费。
5. **Meta plans to raise $95B for AI infrastructure, with Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom as cornerstone investors**: per the Financial Times, the package includes $35B in public equity offerings — another marker of how capital-hungry the AI build-out has become, landing the same day as Anthropic's S-1. https://www.techmeme.com/261026/p15#a261026p15
> **[zh]** **Meta 计划募资 950 亿美元用于 AI 基础设施，英伟达、AMD、博通任基石投资者**：据《金融时报》，其中包括 350 亿美元的公开股权发行——又一个 AI 基建烧钱程度的标志，与 Anthropic 递交 S-1 同日。

### 中文社区
1. **gpu-unlock-ada 爆火：Linux 内核模块解锁 RTX 4090 约 2 倍 FP16/BF16 张量吞吐，L 站网友 4090D 48G 实测成功**：模块在 NVIDIA 驱动启动前打开 SM speed-select 覆盖，FP16/BF16（FP32 累加）指令吞吐从约 165 TF/s 提到约 330 TF/s，INT8 和标量 FP32 不变；但真实 cuBLAS GEMM 只提升 12–34%，量化 MoE 推理几乎无收益，4070 Ti SUPER 为实验支持，约 3.6k star。LinuxDo 网友让 Codex 帮装并借 BMC + 智能插座远程断电重启，大矩阵乘变快、小尺寸反而略降；掘金也把它列为 GitHub 今日推荐。https://linux.do/t/topic/3078123 [GitHub](https://github.com/JustAResearcher/gpu-unlock-ada) [掘金](https://juejin.cn/post/7700050834004426790)
> **[en]** **gpu-unlock-ada goes viral: a Linux kernel module unlocks ~2× FP16/BF16 tensor throughput on RTX 4090, and a LinuxDo user confirms it on a 4090D 48G**: the module enables an SM speed-select override before the NVIDIA driver starts, lifting FP16/BF16 (FP32-accumulate) instruction throughput from ~165 to ~330 TF/s with INT8 and scalar FP32 unchanged; but real cuBLAS GEMM gains are only 12–34%, quantized MoE serving sees almost nothing, 4070 Ti SUPER support is experimental, ~3.6k stars. The LinuxDo user had Codex install it and used a BMC plus smart plug for a remote power-cycle; large matmuls got faster while small sizes dipped slightly. Juejin also featured it as a GitHub pick of the day.
2. **V2EX 分享创造：用 Go 写的个人 coding agent suga，专攻「一个会话陪我干一整天」**：上下文满了不做摘要压缩而是分段，新段带固定结构的交接包，硬约束逐字保留、其他小节有字节预算（没加预算前 14 轮会话里交接包从 4.7 KB 涨到 16 KB）；给写交接包的调用设输出上限后，真实推理模型 4 个任务有 3 个摘要为空——思考把额度吃光了；一句 10 字提问要 8,853 输入 token，大头是工具 schema，低频工具按需加载只省 6.8%，所以默认关闭。MIT，单个二进制。https://www.v2ex.com/t/1251957 [博客](https://inhere.github.io/blog/2026/suga-long-session/) [GitHub](https://github.com/inhere/suga)
> **[en]** **V2EX Show & Tell: suga, a personal coding agent in Go built for "one session that lasts me all day"**: when context fills it segments instead of summarizing, passing a fixed-structure handoff pack where hard constraints are kept verbatim and other sections get byte budgets (before budgets, the pack grew from 4.7 KB to 16 KB over 14 turns); capping output on the handoff call left 3 of 4 summaries empty on a real reasoning model — thinking ate the budget; a 10-character question cost 8,853 input tokens, mostly tool schemas, and lazy-loading rare tools saved only 6.8% overall, so it's off by default. MIT, single binary.
3. **V2EX：yolo-ai，用一个 `yolo` 前缀统一所有 AI CLI 的「跳过权限」开关**：`yolo claude` → `--dangerously-skip-permissions`、`yolo codex` → `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox`、`yolo gemini` → `--yolo`、`yolo aider` → `--yes-always`，支持 9 个 agent，参数原样透传，Windows 三种 shell 都能用；作者明说「Dangerous by design」，提供 `--dry-run`，并建议与 agent 自带沙箱参数组合使用——结合今天 Claude 绕付费墙等新闻，只在可丢弃目录里用。https://www.v2ex.com/t/1252016 [GitHub](https://github.com/2501224066/yolo-ai)
> **[en]** **V2EX: yolo-ai unifies every AI CLI's skip-permissions switch behind one `yolo` prefix**: `yolo claude` → `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, `yolo codex` → `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox`, `yolo gemini` → `--yolo`, `yolo aider` → `--yes-always`; 9 agents supported, args passed through, works in all three Windows shells. The author says it is "Dangerous by design", offers `--dry-run` and suggests pairing it with each agent's own sandbox flags — given today's Claude paywall-bypass news, use it only in throwaway directories.
